decisions.reason: No evidence of performance below aspirations; the module remains part of the modular system and has kept its own product page, so it is retained.
As a replacement for an established voltage measurement module, it likely meets aspirations and supports existing users, so it is retained.
The CAN bus interface is a niche but established module with no documented shortfall, and organizational slack allows carrying it.
The CO2 sensor module remains relevant for air quality monitoring and shows no sign of underperformance relative to aspirations.
